outgoing.name: Australia
outgoing.excerpt: Comet White-Ortiz-Bolelli was first spotted on May 18 by Graeme White, an Australian amateur astronomer in Wollongong, New South Wales.

outgoing.name: Madagascar
outgoing.excerpt: The second independent discovery was made on May 21 by Air France pilot Emilio Ortiz, from a location about 400 km east of Madagascar.
